events.text: Northbridge FC open talks with Riverside FC to sign Leo Silva before the window closes.
Westhaven City bid 59.5M for Leo Silva.

The window closes. Leo Silva joins Westhaven City instead, for 59.5M, because Northbridge FC could not agree the fee (Northbridge's last offer was 49.5M plus up to 15M in add-ons, the asking price was 62M plus up to 6.2M in add-ons, 20% sell-on).
